assessment: This work presents insightful epidemiologic and phylogenetic analyses of tuberculosis cases across Valencia, Spain, and comparator low-burden (Oxfordshire, UK) and high-burden (Karonga, Malawi) regions. Findings reveal that the "low burden" observed in Valencia is not in fact reflective of low transmission in this setting, with detected lineages likely to have circulated locally over the course of decades and to have been transmitted in the community.
